I'll start by reading the docs and the package layout.

I've read the code and the docs. Next I'll make the fixes, starting with `parse.py`.

I fixed the bugs in `patchkit` and wrote `/app/STATUS.json` with status `success`. All 46 unit tests pass (`python -m unittest discover -s tests -t .`). `python tools/check.py --data data` reports 0 broken on all 142 applicable cases. The checker and tests don't decide where a hunk belongs, so I also compared the code with each rule in `docs`. I did not run any extra cases of my own, such as CRLF patches or reverse patches with end-of-file markers.

What I fixed, by file:

- **`parse.py`:**
  - A trailing carriage return on a patch line now counts as part of its line ending.
  - Paths end at the first tab, not at any whitespace, so spaces stay in the path.
  - A range with no count (`-A`, `+C`) now has a count of 1, not 0.
  - Reversing a patch now swaps the end-of-file markers between the old and new sides.
- **`search.py`:**
  - Of two candidate positions at the same distance, the lower line is tried first.
  - Every position is tried at one fuzz level before any position at the next level.
  - A hunk can no longer apply before the end of the previous applied hunk.
- **`apply.py`:**
  - A hunk with an empty old range is expected right after line `A`, not at line `A`.
  - Offsets are the reported line minus the stated line, without subtracting the carried offset.
  - Added lines take the file's line ending instead of always LF.
- **`report.py`:**
  - File entries stay in patch order instead of being sorted by path.
  - `moved` now counts only hunks with a non-zero offset, not fuzzed ones.

`python -m patchkit run` still reports 8 cases as errors, and the ones I looked at are real rule breaks. They are an unknown option, a `../` path, a file the case doesn't have, two sections naming one file, and malformed patch text.

command_result.command: cd /app; find . -type f -not -path './.git/*' | grep -v __pycache__ | head -100; cat docs/overview.md; wc -l docs/* patchkit/*.py
cd /app; cat docs/cases.md docs/patch.md docs/paths.md docs/lines.md docs/apply.md docs/output.md docs/changelog.md; ls docs/archive tools data | head -30
cd /app; for f in patchkit/*.py; do echo "=== $f"; cat -n $f; done
cd /app; cat docs/lines.md; head -12 docs/apply.md; cat patchkit/lines.py patchkit/errors.py; sed -n 48,70p patchkit/cli.py

cd /app && python - <<'EOF'
import re
def sub(path, old, new):
    s = open(path).read()
    assert s.count(old) == 1, (path, old)
    open(path, 'w').write(s.replace(old, new))

p = 'patchkit/parse.py'
sub(p, '''    lines = text.split("\\n")
    if lines and lines[-1] == "":
        lines.pop()
    return lines''', '''    lines = text.split("\\n")
    if lines and lines[-1] == "":
        lines.pop()
        terminated = len(lines)
    else:
        terminated = len(lines) - 1
    for k in range(terminated):
        if lines[k].endswith("\\r"):
            lines[k] = lines[k][:-1]
    return lines''')
sub(p, 'path = re.split(r"\\s", rest, maxsplit=1)[0]', 'path = rest.split("\\t", 1)[0]')
sub(p, 'a, b = int(m[1]), int(m[2]) if m[2] is not None else 0', 'a, b = int(m[1]), (int(m[2]) if m[2] is not None else 1)')
sub(p, 'c, d = int(m[3]), int(m[4]) if m[4] is not None else 0', 'c, d = int(m[3]), (int(m[4]) if m[4] is not None else 1)')
sub(p, 'HunkLine(flip[hl.kind], hl.text, hl.old_eol, hl.new_eol)', 'HunkLine(flip[hl.kind], hl.text, hl.new_eol, hl.old_eol)')

p = 'patchkit/report.py'
sub(p, '    entries.sort(key=lambda e: e["path"])\n', '')
sub(p, 'h["offset"] != 0 or h["fuzz"] > 0', 'h["offset"] != 0')

p = 'patchkit/search.py'
sub(p, '(abs(p - expected), -p)', '(abs(p - expected), p)')
sub(p, 'def locate(h: Hunk, lines: list[Line], start: int, fuzz: int) -> Match | None:', 'def locate(h: Hunk, lines: list[Line], start: int, fuzz: int, floor: int = 0) -> Match | None:')
sub(p, 'candidates(start + top, 0, len(lines) - n)', 'candidates(start + top, floor, len(lines) - n)')
sub(p, 'tries.sort(key=lambda t: (t[1], t[0]))', 'tries.sort(key=lambda t: (t[0], t[1]))')

p = 'patchkit/apply.py'
sub(p, '    return h.old_start - 1', '    return h.old_start - 1 if h.old_len else h.old_start')
sub(p, 'out.append((hl.text, "\\n" if hl.new_eol else ""))', 'out.append((hl.text, ending if hl.new_eol else ""))')
sub(p, '    carry = 0\n', '    carry = 0\n    floor = 0\n')
sub(p, 'expected_start(h) + carry, fuzz)', 'expected_start(h) + carry, fuzz, floor)')
sub(p, '"offset": line - stated - carry,', '"offset": line - stated,')
sub(p, '        carry = line - stated\n', '        carry = line - stated\n        floor = m.pos + n\n')
EOF
python -m unittest discover -s tests -t . 2>&1 | tail -30
cd /app && python tools/check.py --help 2>&1 | head; python tools/check.py data 2>&1 | tail -30; git status --short | head
cd /app && python tools/check.py --data data 2>&1 | tail -30; ls data/cases | wc -l
cd /app && for c in 036 082 117 120; do echo "== $c"; python -c "import json;d=json.load(open('data/cases/case-$c.json'));print(repr(d['patch']))"; done
